Content: MemorySmith now has a request guard middleware at startup. When MemorySmith:AllowRemoteApi is false, non-loopback callers are rejected before reaching controllers. When MemorySmith:ApiKey is configured, /api and /mcp requests must include X-Api-Key with a matching value; null ApiKey remains frictionless for local development. This makes the documented configuration real while keeping the default local workflow open.
Title: Request Guard and Optional API Key Enforcement
